candidate_replacement.hidden_definitions_description: Before compilation the evaluator renames these fixed definitions, which implement the target's behavior, in every source file, so a submission cannot reuse them by name.

test_programs.policy: Run every program in the fixed required-test catalog that matches the selection patterns.

comparison.pass_condition: Every selected program completes with zero RTL-versus-ISA trace mismatches.

fixed_test_patches.purpose: Drive fetch access and page fault responses into a separate IF2 instance in Rift2330. Check that both faults emit one distinguishable fault-marked halfword and the original request PC without a cache request or redirect.
